task.title: ExperimentRun multi-artifact lineage tree
task.summary_zh: 新增多 artifact-type lineage tree：ExperimentRun 可同時產 model_artifact + feature_set + signal_snapshot + optimizer_result，本任務確保 lineage edges 正確連接 N 個 artifact 而非單一。獨立 module。
acceptance: multi_artifact_tree.py exposes get_run_artifacts(experiment_run_id) returning list of artifact records grouped by artifact_type
supports model_artifact feature_set signal_snapshot optimizer_result evaluation_result types
each artifact node carries lineage.parent_run_id pointing back to experiment_run
test fixture creates a run producing 4 artifact types and asserts all retrieved with correct grouping
task.next: Owner finalized Claude-approved closeout; evidence PR #209 merged into dev with focused lineage-read validation passing.
